root.name: Zukertort Opening: The Walrus
root.moves: 1. Nf3 e5 2. Nxe5 Nc6 3. Nxc6 dxc6

overview: Black meets 1.Nf3 e5 2.Nxe5 with the counter 2...Nc6 3.Nxc6 dxc6 (the Walrus), giving the e-pawn for open lines. White is a pawn up with a healthy structure; Black has doubled c-pawns, but open d- and e-files, a lead in development and the two bishops. White aims to consolidate with d3 or e4 and develop; Black aims for ...Bd6, ...Qh4 or ...Bg4 pressure and ...Nf6.

white_ideas.idea: Hold the extra pawn with d3, e3 or e4 and complete development calmly.
Trade queens on the d-file to reach a better structure endgame.

black_ideas.idea: Use the open d-file and quick development with ...Bd6, ...Nf6, ...Bg4 or ...Qh4.
Recover the pawn on e4 or by pressure on the e-file.

typical_structures.structure: White has full pawns against Black's doubled c-pawns, with the d- and e-files half-open.

character.notes: Black plays for activity against a pawn deficit, so the play is forcing and risky for Black.

gambit.notes: White is a pawn up in the FEN after 3...dxc6 and can keep it if he develops accurately.

soundness.notes: White can try to hold the extra pawn without much danger, so the Walrus is considered dubious for Black.

structure.notes: Open d- and e-files and fast piece play, with doubled c-pawns.

approach.notes: A rare gambit-style reply by Black that strong players seldom use.

level.notes: Compensation is positional and hard to judge; a dubious line is never a beginner choice.

plan_phrases: lead in development for the pawn

character.reason: Black plays actively for a pawn with open lines and risk.

gambit.reason: Black is a pawn down in the FEN and plays for compensation.

soundness.reason: White can hold the pawn and the doubled c-pawns are a lasting structural cost.

structure.reason: Open d- and e-files and fast piece development drive the game.

approach.reason: Strong players rarely allow or choose this line.

level.reason: Dubious line, so never beginner, and no long theory.

plans.reason: Black's compensation is the development lead for the missing pawn.
